name: Kichiku Kanojo
source:
Rei's girlfriend, Shino, got involved in an accident and lost her memory.
She has been a quiet and kind girl but now she becomes a very sadistic girl, especially in a sexual way.
She tries to squeeze out his sperm at every possible opportunity.
He accepts her new taste, hoping that she will one day get back to what she was again.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE053571.html]English DLSite[/url]]
